title: Suspicious High-Volume Outbound Data Transfer
executive_summary: The investigation examined the anomalous outbound traffic spike and concluded it corresponds to an authorized nightly database synchronization routine, though bandwidth limits exceeded baseline expectations.

timeline.description: PAM authentication session opened for service account 'svc_backup_agent' via cron scheduler.
Execution of rclone sync process initiated to secure offsite vault.
DNS lookup for backup-vault-us-east.storage-sync.net resolved to 198.51.100.44.
Outbound 542 MB TLS session initiated to 198.51.100.44 over port 443.

hypotheses.explanation: Offsite archival backup initiated by authorized service account.
hypotheses.reasoning: Matches scheduled cron timing and valid change request CR-7719.

hypotheses.explanation: Exfiltration of financial assets by malicious insider or external threat actor.
hypotheses.reasoning: Process lineage and service account credentials indicate legitimate job execution.

key_findings.finding: High outbound volumetric transfer of 542 MB was observed on TCP port 443.
Activity originated from legitimate service account svc_backup_agent executing rclone.
key_findings.significance: Validates authorized software and identity context.

evidence.summary: Outbound TCP session 10.0.4.15:48192 -> 198.51.100.44:443. Duration: 412s. Sent: 542 MB, Recv: 12 KB. State: SF (Normal termination).
DNS query for 'backup-vault-us-east.storage-sync.net' from 10.0.4.15 resolved to 198.51.100.44 (TTL: 300).
PAM authentication session opened for service account 'svc_backup_agent' via local cron scheduler.
Process execution: '/usr/bin/rclone sync /data/finance-archives backup-vault:encrypted-sync --bwlimit 25M' PID: 4912 under UID 1004 (svc_backup_agent).
Registered scheduled cron job '/etc/cron.d/finance-nightly-sync' configured to trigger daily at 22:00 UTC.

uncertainty: Full packet capture payload analysis was unavailable due to end-to-end TLS encryption.
Cloud storage provider access logs at destination IP 198.51.100.44 were not directly queried.

confidence.rationale: Strong corroborating auditd and cron evidence confirms authorized scheduled synchronization despite unusual volume spike.

recommendations.action: Review host activity and verify nightly backup schedule parameters
recommendations.justification: Confirm whether recent data volume increase was anticipated or requires updated bandwidth caps.

recommendations.action: Inspect relevant DNS records and storage endpoint configuration
recommendations.justification: Ensure 198.51.100.44 remains on the approved cloud storage IP allowlist.
Contingency only: not currently recommended as activity is assessed as benign authorized backup.
